description:
Members. Who may write where in a workspace (0.82.0): each folder its owner shared for writing, with the
    members named. A folder with a list is written by the owner and those members, and so is everything beneath it,
    down to the next folder with a list of its own (the nearest list decides). A `.hashn` folder (the index, rule
    files) is the owner's alone unless it has a list. Everywhere else every member writes, as before.
